risks.claim: US tariff and trade policy changes in 2026, including a temporary 15% global tariff, could reduce international passenger traffic and affect Copa's operations
quotes: In 2026, the Supreme Court of the United States invalidated certain expansive tariffs. In response, the U.S. administration implemented a temporary 15% global tariff.
